check_kinds.process: Requires implementation behavior or source evidence; not decidable from one artifact.

rules.requirement: An operational artifact MUST validate against the schema selected by its declared marker and artifact type.
rules.source_text: An operational artifact MUST validate against the schema selected by its declared marker and artifact type.

rules.requirement: Evidence, finding and timeline entry identities MUST be unique across those collections within an artifact.
rules.source_text: Evidence, finding and timeline entry identities MUST be unique across those collections within an artifact.

rules.requirement: Every investigation summary, finding, timeline and recovery citation MUST name an evidence entry declared in that report.
rules.source_text: Every investigation summary, finding, timeline and recovery citation MUST name an evidence entry declared in that report.

rules.requirement: An audit occurred_at, incident detected_at or timeline occurred_at MUST NOT be later than the enclosing artifact created_at.
rules.source_text: An audit occurred_at, incident detected_at or timeline occurred_at MUST NOT be later than the enclosing artifact created_at.

rules.requirement: A verification signal with grounded or partial grounding MUST contain at least one evidence reference.
rules.source_text: A verification signal with grounded or partial grounding MUST contain at least one evidence reference.

rules.requirement: Observed or contradictory investigation claims and verified recovery MUST cite at least one declared evidence entry.
rules.source_text: Observed or contradictory investigation claims and verified recovery MUST cite at least one declared evidence entry.

rules.requirement: An audit event MUST NOT name its own identity in causal_event_ids.
rules.source_text: An audit event MUST NOT name its own identity in causal_event_ids.

rules.requirement: A projection MUST preserve the source producer, native identity, native format and outcome meaning without inventing absent observations.
rules.source_text: A projection MUST preserve the source producer, native identity, native format and outcome meaning without inventing absent observations.

rules.requirement: Producers MUST NOT copy credentials, credential hashes, raw tool arguments or privileged context into operational artifacts, including free text, attributes and extensions.
rules.source_text: Producers MUST NOT copy credentials, credential hashes, raw tool arguments or privileged context into operational artifacts, including free text, attributes and extensions.

rules.requirement: A consumer MUST perform both schema and semantic validation before describing an operational artifact as draft-aligned.
rules.source_text: A consumer MUST perform both schema and semantic validation before describing an operational artifact as draft-aligned.

rules.requirement: A consumer MUST NOT fetch a reference URI or execute its content merely because it appears in an artifact.
rules.source_text: A consumer MUST NOT fetch a reference URI or execute its content merely because it appears in an artifact.

rules.requirement: A consumer MUST preserve unknown attributes and namespaced extensions when forwarding an artifact.
rules.source_text: A consumer MUST preserve unknown attributes and namespaced extensions when forwarding an artifact.

rules.requirement: A consumer MUST NOT treat citation presence, a native outcome, confidence or schema validity as proof of factual truth, authorization, safety, containment or successful recovery.
rules.source_text: A consumer MUST NOT treat citation presence, a native outcome, confidence or schema validity as proof of factual truth, authorization, safety, containment or successful recovery.

rules.requirement: An implementation MUST NOT describe this exploratory draft as stable AIOS conformance.
rules.source_text: An implementation MUST NOT describe this exploratory draft as stable AIOS conformance.
